description:
Prove the create-time graph-rule warnings without cloning a profiled repository onto disk, so these tests stop timing out after a rebuild.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs` holds four tests of the orphan-leaf and strategic-consistency warnings: an epic without its label, a task without a parent, and their no-warning counterparts. The workflow profile's graph rules produce these warnings. Each test clones a `jit-dogfood` profiled repository onto disk and drives `CommandExecutor<JsonFileStorage>`. Quiet and warm they take 0.22-0.24 s. After a rebuild, their cold fixture key under host load drives them past the 20 s nextest bound.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs`: `setup_test_repo` (`:24`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists: it is deleted together with `cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs` once the file's cases have moved down a layer.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each of the four warning properties is proven at the cheapest layer that observes it: the workflow profile's graph rules evaluated in memory over the issues the test creates, with no file-backed repository.
- [hard] REQ-03: The rules come from the workflow profile package's own declarations, not a restated copy.
- [hard] REQ-04: No test of these properties exceeds 5 s on a warm target at load ≤ 10.
- [hard] REQ-05: `cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs` no longer exists once no case remains in it.
- [hard] REQ-06: None of the four cases calls the profiled-repository fixture or takes its cross-process build lock, so neither a missing setup-script receipt nor lock contention can affect them.
title: Create-time rule warnings proven in-process without a profiled repository
